summary: Phase 8 MPCA-116 (Player Registration Campaign request/approval workflow) tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass covering MPCA auto-approve, Division-defaults-Pending, approve/reject role guards, idempotency, empty-reason 400, public token guard for Pending/Rejected/Approved, and division scoping. Frontend: All UI acceptance checks pass — button label swap ('Request Campaign' vs 'New Campaign'), status pills, italic 'Awaiting MPCA approval' line, rejected reason element, conditional visibility of Copy/Invites/Preview only for Approved, MPCA-only Approve/Reject controls, and live status flip after Approve click (Pending → Active).
critical_code_review_comments: PlayerRegistrations.jsx file is 764 lines — consider splitting CampaignsList / RegistrationsInbox / NewCampaignDialog / InvitesDialog into separate files (>700 line guideline).

reject_campaign_request writes approved_by/approved_at when rejecting — semantically these fields represent approver metadata; consider renaming to a neutral 'actioned_by'/'actioned_at' or introducing dedicated rejected_by/rejected_at fields for clarity.
rejectReq handler uses window.prompt() which is not ideal UX — a modal input would be more consistent with the rest of the ERP heritage design.
seed_data_creation: Created ~11 TEST_MPCA116_* campaigns via backend tests (auto-cleaned by teardown attempt; a few visible in UI list are harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: MPCA-116 fully verified. Regression items from Phase 1-7+9 were not re-executed this iteration (Phase 7 iteration_79.json already covered them). Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_mpca_116_campaign_requests.py is a stable regression suite for the campaign workflow.
